name: pi-starline
notes: Forked from Andy8647/pi-starline. The shared mouse API contract lives in openspec/specs/mouse-api; fork behavior and releases are documented in the package README and FORK-CHANGELOG.

knownDebt.reason: Fork release packaging adds declaration build/prepack scripts and dist plus fork release notes to upstream's extensions/types allowlist. Required by the repository publish contract; removable if upstream adopts the same declaration distribution.

The exact published-files assertion follows the intentional fork allowlist including declarations and fork release notes, without relaxing runtime assertions. Reconcile when upstream changes its packaging contract.

The mouse consumer, pointer delegation and adapted upstream integration tests intentionally use pi-mouse-events rather than upstream's separate renderer patches. Keep until upstream adopts a compatible shared mouse API.

The editor factory, frame splitter and prototype registry retain pi-zentui legacy aliases removed upstream so the two packages can coexist in either load order. Remove only when legacy coexistence is no longer supported.
Use Function.prototype.apply.call to preserve predecessor dispatch while satisfying the local no-Reflect.apply rule; remove if upstream adopts equivalent forwarding or the rule changes.
9 lint/style/noNonNullAssertion warnings on an upstream test file, kept by deliberate non-change: warnings do not fail biome check and fixing them would add fork edits inside an upstream file.
2 lint/suspicious/noConfusingVoidType warnings on an upstream test file, kept by deliberate non-change for the same reason.

Residual raw-vs-w delta is a diff-alignment artifact: 19 of the fork's 91 added lines are whitespace-twins of upstream lines (repeated }); closers), so git aligns them differently in raw vs -w. Upstream-original lines are byte-identical to upstream.

reapplyOnSync: mouse features register with the local @xzzpig/pi-mouse-events extension instead of patching TuiAltScreen.prototype (optional peer >=0.2.0 <3, devDep workspace:*); without it fork mouse features are off, with one console note per process; click-away observes shared mouse events and the optional shared pointer API handles hover without a Starline patch
mouse/api-consumer.ts reads Symbol.for('pi-mouse-events.api.v2') and rejects any candidate whose version !== 2, so an older v1 publisher is rejected rather than misread
keep test/contract/mouse-api.test.ts pinning that key plus the version:1 rejection fixture
every git probe in extensions/starline/git.ts passes --no-optional-locks (test/git-no-optional-locks.test.ts)
test/runtime.test.ts passes an explicit empty env to detectRuntime so ambient Nix markers cannot shadow file-marker fixtures
keep the comment-only additions: ui.ts SAFETY/pi-lens-ignore notes and config.ts's empty-catch note

Keep package.json TAB-indented with the fork name/version/dependencies, declaration build:types/prepack scripts, and files allowlist (extensions, dist, types, FORK-CHANGELOG.md). Keep the upstream package-identity test aligned; regenerate the package-lock root identity mechanically with npm, never by hand.

mouse/index.ts stays the fork's consumer-API rewrite; use the optional shared asynchronous copy slot for Pi's native clipboard and retain the synchronous OSC 52 fallback for older v2 publishers; prefer the shared post-component wheel slot and Pi's computed delta, falling back to the older pre-dispatch slot when unavailable
preserve pi-zentui legacy symbol interoperability in editor-factory-marker.ts, ui.ts and prototype-patch-registry.ts and retain test/legacy-symbols.test.ts when upstream removes the aliases
delegate mouse/pointer-shape.ts requests to the shared pointer coordinator; keep the fork pill-mouse observer and adapt upstream external-layer and clipboard tests to the shared consumer architecture
keep typed pointer-shape prototype and safe Function.prototype.apply.call forwarding in pointer-shape.ts and queue-rows.ts when upstream changes these methods
keep clickToToggleExpandable (default true) across the config.ts sites and the test files; clickToExpandTools is not restored anywhere

keep handlesMouse() deleted, mouse/hit-test.ts at fork HEAD, key-text.ts at upstream bytes as the single source with tool-box.ts/index.ts importing keyTextFor from ./key-text, and capabilities.ts's D8 type tightening (<T extends object>)
keep Pi peer ranges >=1.0.0 <2 with catalog devDependencies; retain the optional pi-mouse-events v2 API contract
